in_sanskrit.name: एश्वानी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Eshwaani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eshu' which refers to the god of love and fertility. The suffix 'ani' is a common feminine suffix in Sanskrit and Indian languages, which means 'female' or 'goddess'. Thus, Eshwaani can be interpreted as the 'female manifestation of the god of love and fertility'.

in_hindi.name: एश्वानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Eshwaani is translated as 'wife of Eshu'. Eshu is the name of a Hindu god who is known as the god of love and fertility. Thus, Eshwaani is a name that honors and celebrates the god of love and fertility, while also signifying the feminine and nurturing aspects of the goddess.

Thus, Eshwaani is a name that signifies the feminine and nurturing aspects of the goddess of love and fertility.

in_telugu.name: ఏశ్వాని

in_marathi.name: Eshwaani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Gods
